scientific.integrity: The source population-gain formula is specialized directly to an i.i.d. random-curvature quadratic. The gain, conditional second moment, stability boundary, and optimizer are derived exactly from the first two curvature moments; finite enumeration is used only as a transcription guard.
limitations: Population gain rather than the practical moving-average gain estimator.
Scalar i.i.d. nonnegative random curvature with finite second moment.
No multidimensional noncommuting-Hessian or almost-sure boundary claim.

title: Population AdaScale preserves the exact mean-square stability frontier across scales
